trans-unit.source: Allow writes approved in advance: when enabled, a conversation whose "approve automatically" switch is on skips the approval card for permitted write tools. Off means every write stops and asks.
Attachment storage: FAL combined identifier of the folder chat attachments are stored below, per backend user and conversation.
nr-llm configuration: identifier of the nr-llm LLM configuration the chat runs under (provider, model, system prompt, budget). The chat is unavailable while it cannot be resolved.
Turns per hour and user: how many turns one backend user may start per hour across all conversations. 0 disables the limit.
Toolbar item: offer the AI Assistant as a dropdown of the backend toolbar.
